modules.name: AnA Authoring Engine
modules.description: Capability overview of the CTD authoring engine: the raw-data-to-draft pipeline, the drafting system for each document type, and the deterministic post-checks that run before a draft is promoted. This page describes coverage and does not read your programs — the document editor is where authoring happens.

modules.name: Parallel drafting
modules.description: AnA drafts several dossier sections in parallel. Each section arrives as its own draft for you to accept, and an accepted draft is saved through the same governed section save as an edit you make yourself.

modules.name: CMC / Module 3
modules.description: Module 3 operating system: blueprint, specifications, stability, batch records, convergence.

modules.name: CSR workflow
modules.description: ICH E3 CSR builder + intelligence library.

modules.name: 510(k) and eSTAR
modules.description: 510(k) and eSTAR — the eSTAR section tree, content editor, and predicate and substantial-equivalence analysis in one place.

modules.name: Clinical evaluation (CER)
modules.description: Clinical Evaluation Reports for EU MDR — Annex XIV structure, literature and vigilance evidence, GSPR checklist, and export.

modules.name: IVDR evidence
modules.description: IVD and diagnostics evidence — classification, analytical and clinical performance, risk analysis, and IVDR, CLIA, CDx and LDT pathways.

modules.name: PMA
modules.description: PMA submissions for Class III devices — module status, clinical trial metrics, and pathway progress across the program.

modules.name: Pre-submission (Q-Sub)
modules.description: Pre-submission and Q-Sub management — meeting requests, briefing packages, agency feedback, and the commitments that follow.

modules.name: Document journey
modules.description: One document, ideation → submission: ideate → outline → AnA draft → revise → review → QC → approve (§11 e-sign) → assemble (eCTD leaf) → transmit (ESG). Document state visible at every stage.

modules.name: The editor
modules.description: The regulatory document editor — simultaneous co-authoring, tracked changes, comments, version history, review, approval and electronic signature.

modules.name: eCTD co-author
modules.description: eCTD tree + section authoring. Back-half pipeline (format→assemble→validate→transmit) is production-grade.

modules.name: Compile & Export eCTD
modules.description: Compile, validate and export a submission-ready eCTD backbone across FDA and EMA for a program.

modules.name: Inconsistency Intelligence
modules.description: Change a governed value once and propagate it to every document that cites it. Draft sections update in place; approved sections are flagged for re-approval with a task and an audit entry.

modules.name: Labeling
modules.description: Device labeling and instructions for use — authoring, the symbols register, and translation workflow.

modules.name: Prescribing information
modules.description: USPI (PLLR / 21 CFR 201.57), EU SmPC (QRD), SPL. End-of-review agency labeling negotiation (sponsor vs FDA redline). The label as the document.

modules.name: Nonclinical / Module 4
modules.description: IND-enabling & CTD Module 4: GLP study registry with finding classification and SEND status, SEND 12-domain conformance, the Module 2.6 written/tabulated summary builder, and Module 4 placement. Structured data entry for studies.

modules.name: The protocol workspace
modules.description: Protocol authoring hub (C2C-17..22): full eCTD-style section tree, SoA grid, risk register (5×5), milestones, budget/feasibility, amendments, deviations/CAPA, reviews, informed consent — deterministic completeness gate on finalize (ICH M11 / 45 CFR 46 / PHS Policy).

modules.name: Source Tracer
modules.description: Sentence-level provenance. Every claim carries a typed source link with a confidence score, untraced claims are surfaced, and citations are verified against PubMed and CrossRef.

modules.name: Template library
modules.description: Organization-scoped template store — extract templates from existing documents, author from a specification, and render to Word or PDF.

modules.name: Decision lineage
modules.description: The immutable, hash-chained record behind every governed artifact: who decided what, when, on what evidence, and signed how. Verifiable and exportable.

modules.name: Device clinical studies
modules.description: Study list, detail, summaries, archetypes and RBM attention. Six endpoints; distinct from clinical-ops, which is the drug-trial operations surface.

modules.name: Engineering evidence
modules.description: Program-scoped engineering rollup. Distinct from design-controls and human-factors, which are org-scoped registers.

modules.name: Software lifecycle
modules.description: IEC 62304 software lifecycle and completeness summary. The only implementation in the product.

modules.name: Evidence search (RAG)
modules.description: Ask a question across the corpus — 3-layer memory → gateway → cited answer traced back to source chunks.

modules.name: Human factors (IEC 62366-1)
modules.description: Usability engineering under IEC 62366-1 — use-related risk analysis and critical tasks, formative and summative evaluation, and the usability engineering file that supports the submission.

modules.name: Reporting & analytics
modules.description: Conversational governed reporting — a per-segment catalog of report types and best-practice packs, assembled by AnA and traceable to source.

modules.name: Vault
modules.description: Drag-drop upload, chunking/embedding progress, semantic search, version history, evidence linking.

modules.name: Gateway transmittals
modules.description: Dispatch submissions to agencies across regions — gateway roster, credential status, governed transmit with re-authentication, and acknowledgement tracking.

modules.name: Health authority questions
modules.description: Health-authority questions — agency information requests, Day-120 lists of questions and complete response letters, logged by round, routed to review and approval, and assembled into a response package from the approved answers.

modules.name: Submission pyramid
modules.description: Deterministic submission work breakdown — submission type selector, phase and task drill-down, critical path, and progress analytics.

modules.name: Submission Center
modules.description: The submission workspace — package assembly and preview, validation, and dispatch by agency gateway or eSTAR export.

modules.name: Submission Twin
modules.description: Living submission intelligence — readiness and fragility scoring, narrative drift detection, simulated reviewer challenges, and change-impact analysis.

modules.name: Submission Readiness
modules.description: The final gate before transmit — structural validation, unacknowledged critical findings, and validator results, in one decision.

modules.name: Enterprise identity (SSO / SCIM)
modules.description: SCIM provisioning tokens (issue-once/rotate/enable/revoke, §11.10(d) hash-only storage), SCIM IP allowlist, and the live SAML endpoint references for IdP configuration.

modules.name: Orchestration & readiness
modules.description: Persisted workflow engine: workflowRuns (steps · blockers · diffs · pause/resume/retry), approvalCheckpoints (manual/role/quorum/auto), readiness rules + evaluations → overall score, blocker count, isReady gate before filing.

modules.name: Quality management plans
modules.description: Quality management plans — lifecycle, completeness, gate-level status and risk factors.

modules.name: Quality
modules.description: SOP and controlled-document register with periodic review and read-and-understood tracking, plus the change-control log.

modules.name: Report governance
modules.description: Sealed-report lifecycle — cryptographic integrity verification, provenance and attestations, and governed sealing and revocation with justification.

modules.name: The review board
modules.description: Review queue, threaded comments (open/resolved/outdated), reject-with-reason, e-sign manifestation (21 CFR §11.50).

modules.name: Shadow review
modules.description: AnA simulates the reviewer — FDA filing, EMA Day 120, PMDA, and MDR and IVDR notified body — and scores refuse-to-file and major-deficiency risk before you submit.

modules.name: Tasks
modules.description: Task board with dependency mapping and critical path, plus channels, messages, activity and mentions.

modules.name: FDA CRL library
modules.description: Searchable library of FDA complete-response findings, drawn from the same regulatory evidence graph that CSR authoring, study design and AnA read.

modules.name: Deep research
modules.description: Long-running multi-source research (Opus). Shares the AnA rail in deep-research mode.

modules.name: Post-market surveillance and CAPA
modules.description: Device MDR/MAUDE vigilance and CAPA triage. A different regulatory regime from pv-cockpit, which is drug pharmacovigilance.

modules.name: Global regulatory intelligence
modules.description: Global regulatory intelligence — country and region requirements, pathway comparison, and market-by-market planning.

modules.name: Intelligence catalog
modules.description: Reference catalog of the deterministic tools available across regulatory domains, with the trust level of each.

modules.name: Precedent intelligence
modules.description: Past approvals search + decision rationale. Slots into 510(k) §12 substantial equivalence.

modules.name: Change assessment
modules.description: Change impact engine: FDA "When to Submit a 510(k) for a Change" (2017) + EU MDR significant-change (MDCG 2020-3) determinations → new submission vs document-to-file.

modules.name: UDI & device identification
modules.description: UDI/GUDID summary and document catalog. The only UDI surface; labeling itself lives on the labeling surface.

modules.name: Lifecycle management
modules.description: Post-approval: supplements/variations (sBLA, Type II/IB, CBE-30), CMC change control classified against ICH Q12, and renewal cycles (PADER, 5-year, re-examination).

modules.name: Market access
modules.description: Commercial bridge: payer coverage (CMS NCD/LCD, private, HTA), value-dossier composer (AMCP/NICE/budget-impact), coding strategy (CPT/PLA/HCPCS), access sequencing.

modules.name: Orphan & rare
modules.description: Orphan-drug / rare-disease designations across FDA/EMA/PMDA, RPD priority-review vouchers & grants, and patient-advocacy engagement.

modules.name: Pediatric (PIP / PSP)
modules.description: FDA §505B PREA / iPSP and EMA PIP: plans, deferrals, waivers, extrapolation rationale and PREA milestones.

modules.name: Regulatory change intelligence
modules.description: Portfolio horizon scan: monitors FDA guidance, ISO/IEC revisions, EU MDCG/MDR-IVDR and statutory changes; assesses impact and resolves each to an action document (gap analysis, transition plan, update task) — never a passive feed.

modules.name: Registrations
modules.description: Global registration lifecycle: market authorization status, agency review clocks, renewals/variations, HA commitments, reliance-pathway strategy.

modules.name: Program journey
modules.description: The end-to-end biotech/pharma spine — concept to submission to lifecycle. 9 lifecycle stages, each with its agency gate, deliverables and the deep-linked capabilities that serve it, plus program intelligence: CTD readiness, review clock, predicted HAQs, contradictions and blockers.

modules.name: Communication
modules.description: The regulated FDA↔client loop: agency communications (9 source types) auto-generating tasks, submission lifecycle incl. CRL/RTF/denial (rejected_or_remediation) → response → resubmit, HA interactions + PMR/PMC/REMS commitments, authority profiles.

modules.name: IND forms
modules.description: IND forms — the IND checklist and Module 1 forms (1571, 1572, 3674); the cover letter, briefing book, Letter of Authorization and Statement of Right of Reference; and annual reports and amendments placed into the IND's eCTD sequence. IND safety reports are not part of this release.

modules.name: MAA Module 1 (Regional)
modules.description: Regional marketing-application administrative module (eCTD Module 1) — per-agency required-component checklist for EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, Swissmedic and NMPA over the regional Module 1 requirements engine.

modules.name: NDA / BLA filing
modules.description: NDA/BLA filing cockpit: CTD M1–5 readiness, Module 1 admin set (356h), PDUFA review clock, Refuse-to-File risk (shadow review).

modules.name: Product development (PDEV → IND)
modules.description: Product development through IND — activity tracking, AI drafting, evidence capture and confirmation across CMC, nonclinical, clinical and regulatory.

modules.name: Biostatistics
modules.description: SAP authoring, power analysis, TLF shells, adaptive trial plans, IDMC.

modules.name: Clinical operations
modules.description: Clinical-development operations: studies & enrollment, study sites with RBM risk linkage, DSMB / interim reviews, and protocol deviations with CAPA. Structured data entry for sites and deviations.

modules.name: Pharmacovigilance
modules.description: Safety surveillance: signal detection (PRR/FAERS/EudraVigilance), PSUR/PBRER aggregate-report cycles, expedited 7/15-day submissions across approved products.

modules.name: PV cockpit
modules.description: Pharmacovigilance workbench — safety KPIs, disproportionality screening, expedited reporting clocks, and a regional compliance matrix.

modules.name: Risk-based monitoring
modules.description: Risk-based monitoring under ICH E6(R3) — risk assessment, key risk indicators, quality tolerance limits, central monitoring and site risk.

modules.name: Safety narrative / PV
modules.description: SAE narrative generation, ICSR, signal handling.

modules.name: Sponsor portfolio
modules.description: CRO multi-sponsor rollup. croClients → croStudies → croRegulatorySubmissions, every query org-scoped. Drill into a sponsor; each submission flows through its matching pathway onto the shared Submission Center lifecycle.

modules.name: Projects
modules.description: The portfolio entry point — programs, status and starred work; the door to everything else.

modules.name: Research administration
modules.description: Research-administration workspace (C2C-14/15/16/01-02): IRB/IACUC/IBC governance with convene→quorum→voting poll + finalize determination, Medicare coverage analysis (NCD 310.1) billing grid, intelligent grant finder (fit scoring), CITI training matrix, continuing-review portfolio analytics.
